pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: single hip over the whole 52 by 57 ft footprint, short N-S ridge from about (550,467) to (552,507); W and E faces about 8/12 and reach the N eave on both sides of the diamond

pieces.name: north_diamond
pieces.notes: dark diamond on the N half is ONE north-facing plane about 7.5/12 per LiDAR (not flat, not a skylight); it is lowest at the N eave apex (548,356) and highest at the ridge end (550,470); its SW and SE edges are the main N hip lines, its NW and NE edges are steps against the main W and E faces

exclude_notes: separate lower roof touching the S eave, detached garage or neighbour structure
notes: One 2-story hip block (long N and E shadow bands). The dark diamond is a north-facing plane, its two upper edges are not valleys but steps where the main W and E faces run past it to the N eave. Confidence high on the block, medium on the diamond edges.
